summary: End-to-end backend + frontend testing of rampX. 16/16 backend pytest cases passed (auth, workspace, research). Full frontend flow verified live: onboarding -> real Gemini research (~35s) -> dashboard with 4 competitors + 12 flashcards, save-banner + register from anon workspace, board add, goals add, decisions add with goal tag on timeline, learning-next advances card, and workspace/token persist after reload.

minor.issue: allow_origins is hardcoded to FRONTEND_URL + http://localhost:3000; allow_credentials=True with wildcard would break, but current explicit list is fine. Just note that additional preview domains would need env update.
500 on LLM/scrape failure returns generic 'Research failed'; no retry. Given ~35s runtime this is acceptable but flaky under network issues.

issues: 'Sign out' button label wraps to two lines inside the pill on desktop viewport (visible in dashboard screenshot) - purely cosmetic, consider whitespace-nowrap or shorter label

action_items: OPTIONAL cosmetic: add whitespace-nowrap to nav-logout button in TopNav.jsx to prevent 'Sign out' label wrapping.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses os.environ[...] with hard KeyError on boot (good fail-fast). JWT_SECRET is committed to /app/backend/.env - fine for preview but must be rotated for production.

get_current_user reads token from cookie OR Bearer header - fine, but cookie is never set by /auth/login (only access_token in JSON body); if cookie-based auth is desired for CSRF-safe usage, set httpOnly cookie on login/register.
startup seed_admin re-hashes admin password on every boot when env password differs from stored hash - idempotent and matches auth playbook. Good.

Frontend AppContext persists workspace to localStorage synchronously and PUTs to backend with a 700ms debounce - reasonable. However persist() silently swallows API errors (.catch(() => {})), so a failed save would be invisible to the user. Consider surfacing a save-error toast.
Onboarding.jsx auto-redirects to /dashboard if workspace exists on mount (useEffect with []). This is what enabled our reload-persistence test, good.
scraper.py has 8s per-request timeout with only 2 attempts and 6 queries -> theoretical worst-case ~96s scrape time. For the current test it completed comfortably within 60s.
server.py returns 500 with detail 'Research failed. Please try again.' on any exception in run_research; consider distinguishing scraper vs LLM vs JSON-parse errors for observability.
test_credentials: admin@rampx.io / admin123 (seeded). Frontend test user created dynamically e.g. e2e_e3ccb7bd@rampx.io / test1234.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral test users (email prefix e2e_...) and TEST_ prefixed workspace data via API tests. No cleanup needed - unique random emails per run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py covers all endpoints incl. slow /api/research (~35s using Gemini 3.1 Pro on 'Notion'). Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml (takes ~45s total due to research). Frontend flow requires onboarding to complete before /dashboard is reachable (guarded by RequireWorkspace). REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is https://rampx-hub.preview.emergentagent.com. Token stored in localStorage as 'rampx_token', workspace in 'rampx_workspace'.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues found. Only a minor cosmetic wrap on the 'Sign out' pill in TopNav on desktop viewport.
